next_step_summary: PR #221 is a bounded corrective found during the post-#220 device smoke: grayscale and accepted 1-degree deskew worked, but crop still failed on a page with roughly 15% obvious outside-page background because the text-content path returned rotation_only with content_touches_frame. The prepared-image consumer now attempts a separate physical document-boundary crop only for that exact narrow state. Boundary evidence is derived from a <=900-long-side local analysis bitmap using center-versus-corner luminance contrast, row/column paper occupancy, conservative padding, minimum removable area, the existing deskew matrix, and dominant-line containment; any uncertainty preserves the PR #220 deskewed full-frame fallback. Existing accepted safe-crop behavior, angle thresholds, ContentRegionEstimator, SafeCropEstimator, perspective behavior, OCR/network/provider/dependency/permission/workflow behavior and privacy boundary are unchanged. Continue android-document-preprocess-device-smoke-v1 by rerunning the same photographed regression page and verifying that useful outside background is removed without losing page content; then continue the two owner-controlled contract sets if the result is correct.
